legend: As you might already know, space has always been a problem in ICPC Jakarta. To cope with this, ICPC Jakarta is planning to build two new buildings. These buildings should have a shape of a rectangle of the same size. Now, their problem is to find land to build the buildings.

There are N$$$N$$$ lands available for sale. The ith$$$i^{th}$$$ land has a rectangular shape of size Li×Wi$$$L_i \times W_i$$$. For a good feng shui, the building's side should be parallel to the land's sides.

One way is to build the two buildings on two different lands, one on each land (not necessarily with the same orientation). A building of size A×B$$$A \times B$$$ can be build on the ith$$$i^{th}$$$ land if and only if at least one of the following is satisfied:
A≤Li$$$A \le L_i$$$ and B≤Wi$$$B \le W_i$$$, or
A×2≤Li$$$A \times 2 \le L_i$$$ and B≤Wi$$$B \le W_i$$$, or
A×2≤Wi$$$A \times 2 \le W_i$$$ and B≤Li$$$B \le L_i$$$, or
A≤Li$$$A \le L_i$$$ and B×2≤Wi$$$B \times 2 \le W_i$$$, or

Your task in this problem is to help ICPC Jakarta to figure out the largest possible buildings they can build given N$$$N$$$ available lands. Note that ICPC Jakarta has to build two buildings of A×B$$$A \times B$$$; output the largest possible for A×B$$$A \times B$$$.
input: Input begins with a line containing an integer: N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤100000$$$1 \le N \le 100\,000$$$) representing the number of available lands. The next N$$$N$$$ lines each contains two integers: Li$$$L_i$$$ Wi$$$W_i$$$ (1≤Li,Wi≤109$$$1 \le L_i, W_i \le 10^9$$$) representing the size of the land.
output: Output in a line a number representing the largest building that ICPC Jakarta can build with exactly one decimal point (see sample input/output for clarity).
note: Two buildings of 2.5×5$$$2.5 \times 5$$$ can be built both on the first land.
Two buildings of 2×4$$$2 \times 4$$$ can be built each on the first and second lands.
Two buildings of 7×6$$$7 \times 6$$$ can be built each on the second and third lands.

legend.ai: 如你可能已经知道的那样，空间一直是 ICPC Jakarta 面临的问题。为了解决这个问题，ICPC Jakarta 计划建造两栋新楼。这两栋楼应当是大小相同的矩形。现在，他们的问题是寻找用于建造这两栋楼的土地。
有 N$$$N$$$ 块土地可供出售。第 i 块$$$i^{th}$$$ 土地的形状为矩形，大小为 Li×Wi$$$L_i \times W_i$$$。为了拥有良好的风水，建筑物的边应与土地的边平行。
一种方法是在两块不同的土地上分别建造一栋楼(两栋楼的朝向不一定相同)。大小为 A×B$$$A \times B$$$ 的建筑物可以建在第 i 块$$$i^{th}$$$ 土地上，当且仅当满足以下条件之一：
A≤Li$$$A \le L_i$$$ 且 B≤Wi$$$B \le W_i$$$，或者
A×2≤Li$$$A \times 2 \le L_i$$$ 且 B≤Wi$$$B \le W_i$$$，或
A×2≤Wi$$$A \times 2 \le W_i$$$ 且 B≤Li$$$B \le L_i$$$，或
A≤Li$$$A \le L_i$$$ 且 B×2≤Wi$$$B \times 2 \le W_i$$$，或
在本题中，你需要帮助 ICPC Jakarta 根据 N$$$N$$$ 块可用土地确定他们能够建造的建筑的最大可能尺寸。注意，ICPC Jakarta 必须建造两座尺寸为 A×B$$$A \times B$$$ 的建筑；请输出 A×B$$$A \times B$$$ 的最大可能值。

input.ai: 输入第一行包含一个整数：N$$$N$$$(1≤N≤100000$$$1 \le N \le 100\,000$$$)，表示可用土地的数量。接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数：Li$$$L_i$$$ Wi$$$W_i$$$(1≤Li,Wi≤109$$$1 \le L_i, W_i \le 10^9$$$)，表示土地的大小。

output.ai: 输出一个数字，表示 ICPC Jakarta 能够建造的最大建筑数量，结果必须保留一位小数（具体说明请参见输入输出样例）。

note.ai: 输入输出样例 #1 解释
第一块土地上可以建造两栋大小为 2.5×5$$$2.5 \times 5$$$ 的建筑。
输入输出样例 #2 解释
第一块和第二块土地上分别可以建造两栋大小为 2×4$$$2 \times 4$$$ 的建筑。
样例输入/输出 #3 的解释
在第二块和第三块土地上各可以建造一栋 7×6$$$7 \times 6$$$ 的建筑。
